jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Onboard new customers onto AWS by setting up secure multi-account landing zones using Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA) on AWS, including account structure, guardrails, and baselines Offboard customers cleanly and safely by decommissioning accounts and resources with the right controls and handover Apply AWS security best practices across customer environments, including IAM, guardrails, security baselines, and monitoring aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
